complaints.title: Major water pipe burst flooding Main Street market area
complaints.description: A 12-inch underground main water line has ruptured near Civic Center, Gulshan-e-Iqbal. Clean drinking water is gushing out rapidly, flooding street vendors and creating traffic gridlock. Water pressure in nearby residential blocks has dropped completely.

location.address: Main University Road, near Civic Center

complaints.priorityReasoning: High volume drinking water loss affecting commercial zone and entire residential sector water pressure. Imminent property damage risk.
complaints.summary: Ruptured 12" main water conduit causing commercial flooding & residential pressure outage.
recommendedActions: Shut off primary isolator valve at main junction
Deploy emergency dewatering pump vehicle
Issue local boil water alert as precautionary measure
complaints.imageAnalysis: Severe high-pressure water plume detected overflowing asphalt pavement, standing water depth approx 6 inches.

aiClassification.reason: Large visible water discharge from a municipal pipe in commercial sector.

complaints.title: Deep hazardous pothole on Shahrah-e-Faisal service road
complaints.description: A massive 3-foot wide, 8-inch deep pothole has opened up after heavy monsoon rains. Two motorbikes have already lost control this morning. Exposed gravel and jagged asphalt edges present severe risk during night time due to poor lighting.

location.address: Shahrah-e-Faisal Service Road, near Gulberg Chowrangi

complaints.priorityReasoning: High-speed roadway hazard causing two-wheeler accidents and vehicular tire damage.
complaints.summary: Deep 3ft pothole on high-speed service road causing vehicle accidents.
recommendedActions: Place reflectorized warning cones immediately
Dispatch cold-mix asphalt quick-patch team
Inspect sub-base for structural soil erosion
complaints.imageAnalysis: Asphalt surface depression with severe rim cracking, depth estimated ~7-9 inches.

aiClassification.reason: Deep road surface defect presenting hazard to vehicles.

complaints.title: Overflowing community garbage dumpster attracting strays
complaints.description: The municipal waste bin behind Green Park society in North Nazimabad has not been cleared in 4 days. Waste is spilling onto the public sidewalk, emitting foul odor and attracting stray animals and insects.

location.address: Behind Green Park Society, Block B

complaints.priorityReasoning: Public health and sanitation hazard in high-density residential area, uncollected solid waste over 72h.
complaints.summary: Overflowing residential dumpster overflowing onto sidewalk, sanitation risk.
recommendedActions: Dispatch heavy hydraulic compactor truck
Disinfect dumpster perimeter with anti-microbial spray
Re-evaluate collection schedule for North Nazimabad route
complaints.imageAnalysis: Overflowing 4-cubic-yard waste container with uncontained plastic bags spilling onto pedestrian walkway.

aiClassification.reason: Low confidence detected due to green background elements in photo.

categoryOverride.overrideReason: Photo shows overflowing waste bin behind housing complex, not park land.

complaints.title: Sparking electrical transformer pole near primary school
complaints.description: The utility pole transformer on Shahrah-e-Liaquat, Saddar is emitting loud buzzing sounds and intermittent sparks. Sparks are landing on nearby tree branches near a primary school.
complaints.priorityReasoning: Immediate electrical fire hazard and electrocution risk adjacent to primary school children zone.
complaints.summary: Sparking transformer pole adjacent to primary school, high fire & safety risk.
recommendedActions: Isolate local feeder circuit remotely
Dispatch emergency high-voltage emergency repair crew
Cordon off 50m radius around school entrance
complaints.imageAnalysis: Transformer unit overhead with visible scorching marks and hanging branches near primary distribution lines.

aiClassification.reason: Immediate sparking high-voltage infrastructure near children.

complaints.title: Blocked storm drain causing monsoon waterlogging
complaints.description: Heavy leaf debris and construction sludge have clogged the main stormwater grate at Liaquatabad No. 10 crossing. Rainwater is standing 1 foot deep, entering nearby shop fronts.
complaints.priorityReasoning: Urban drainage block entering retail establishments, causing business interruption and water damage.
complaints.summary: Clogged storm drain grate causing commercial waterlogging at Liaquatabad crossing.
recommendedActions: Deploy suction gulley vacuum truck
Remove debris grate obstruction manually
Clear downstream culvert
complaints.imageAnalysis: Submerged street gutter with dense organic debris covering cast iron catch basin grate.
complaints.resolutionNotes: Suction jetting unit cleared 120kg of silt and leaf debris. Storm drain restored to 100% flow capacity.

citizenFeedback.comment: Excellent quick response by the drainage crew! Water drained completely in 30 minutes.

complaints.title: Fallen heavy tree branch blocking pedestrian park pathway
complaints.description: A large tree branch broke during yesterday storm and is blocking the main jogging track in Sunset Community Park, DHA Phase 6. Elderly visitors cannot pass.
complaints.priorityReasoning: Non-emergency obstruction on pedestrian walkway inside park, no active damage or immediate life threat.
complaints.summary: Fallen tree limb blocking park pathway loop.
recommendedActions: Dispatch chainsaw crew to section fallen limb
Chip wood debris for park mulch
Perform canopy integrity check on parent tree
complaints.imageAnalysis: Large tree branch (~10 inch diameter) lying horizontally across paved 6ft park pathway.

complaints.title: Broken footpath slabs outside bus stop endangering pedestrians
complaints.description: Several concrete footpath slabs on Rashid Minhas Road have cracked and lifted, exposing a 2-foot deep gap right at the NIPA bus stop. Commuters, especially elderly passengers, are at risk of tripping and falling during peak hours.

location.address: Rashid Minhas Road, near NIPA bus stop

complaints.priorityReasoning: Pedestrian trip hazard at high-footfall transit stop, exposed cavity near school crossing route.
complaints.summary: Lifted footpath slabs creating open cavity beside bus stop platform.
recommendedActions: Cordon off affected slabs with safety barriers
Break out damaged concrete and re-lay base layer
Re-cast 12m stretch with high-strength concrete mix
complaints.imageAnalysis: Raised and fractured concrete paving slabs with visible open gap along pedestrian walkway edge.

aiClassification.reason: Clear pedestrian infrastructure damage in transit area.

complaints.title: Sinkhole opening up on Shahrah-e-Noor Jahan main road
complaints.description: A 4-foot wide sinkhole has formed in the middle of the right lane on Shahrah-e-Noor Jahan after a suspected underground water pipe leak eroded the sub-base. Two cars suffered tyre damage overnight and the hole is growing.
complaints.priorityReasoning: Active road collapse in busy through-lane, vehicle damage already reported, risk of further cave-in.
complaints.summary: Expanding sinkhole in main carriageway caused by pipe-leak sub-base erosion.
recommendedActions: Close affected lane with barriers and divert traffic
Dispatch engineering survey team to assess cavity extent
Coordinate with Water & Sanitation Authority to isolate leaking main
complaints.imageAnalysis: Large collapsed asphalt crater in road centre with exposed cavity and minor water pooling at base.

aiClassification.reason: Visible road cavity with vehicle damage reports in busy lane.

complaints.title: Streetlight pole leaning over railway crossing
complaints.description: A streetlight pole on the approach road to the railway crossing has tilted dangerously after last week storm and remains unrepaired. The pole leans over the pedestrian path and could fall onto the tracks.

location.address: Approach road to railway crossing, DHA Phase 6

complaints.priorityReasoning: Leaning pole on approach road; low immediate traffic impact but safety risk if it falls.
complaints.summary: Tilted streetlight pole pending repair at railway crossing approach.
recommendedActions: Inspect pole base for foundation erosion
Stabilize with guy wires until replacement
Schedule pole replacement within the week
